notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id.

This is a THIRD, independent synthetic application (Copper State Handrail Co.) against the same true_requirements.json as data/140p6426q0127_piro_handrail -- built specifically to add another contradictory example of a fresh shape (a schedule/timeline self-contradiction: a 10-business-day mobilization claim in the Capabilities Statement versus a 45-day shop-backlog admission later in the same quote), distinct from application.txt's revenue-figure contradiction and application_b.txt's brand-substitution contradiction.

Most other topics are given straightforward compliant treatment in this variant since the goal of this pass is specifically to add contradictory-class density and format diversity, not to re-exercise every failure shape again.
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone.

primary_verdict / primary_verdict_source (added by SFT data-prep pass): a single training-target label per topic, additive -- acceptable_verdicts is unchanged and remains the source of truth for verdict-accuracy scoring. primary_verdict is the pipeline's own correct prediction where one exists (source: pipeline_prediction), else acceptable_verdicts[0] (source: acceptable_verdicts_first). null for topics with acceptable_verdicts: null (excluded from SFT training, same as they're excluded from verdict scoring).

verdicts.description: Must be a small business under NAICS 238990 with a size standard of $19M average annual revenue.
verdicts.rationale: Application states a single, consistent average annual receipts figure ($6.2M) clearly under the $19M size standard.

evidence.quote:
Copper State Handrail Co. reported average annual receipts of $6.2
million over our three most recently completed fiscal years

verdicts.description: Company must obtain and provide a Unique Entity Identifier (UEI).

verdicts.description: SAM registration must be active at quote close, at award, and throughout contract performance, no exceptions.
verdicts.rationale: is_text_verifiable: false -- genuine SAM registration status cannot be confirmed from application text.

verdicts.description: Company must not have any unpaid Federal tax liability that has been assessed and for which all remedies have been exhausted (narrow exceptions apply only if the awarding agency has already considered and waived suspension/debarment); attested via self-representation in the application.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly represents no unpaid federal tax liability.

verdicts.description: Company must not have been convicted of a Federal felony criminal violation within the preceding 24 months (narrow exceptions apply only if the awarding agency has already considered and waived suspension/debarment); attested via self-representation in the application.
verdicts.rationale: Application explicitly represents no felony conviction within the preceding 24 months.

evidence.quote:
Copper State Handrail Co. has not been convicted of a felony

verdicts.description: Offeror must complete the attached Price Schedule in its entirety, unedited except for units/quantities, no alternates.
verdicts.rationale: Item 10 price and total are both filled in.

verdicts.description: The Price Schedule template must not be edited except to add units of measure/quantities; if changes are needed, an addendum explaining them must be provided alongside the unedited schedule.

verdicts.description: If quoting an "or equal" item, must submit detailed product specification/literature confirming comparability.
verdicts.rationale: Application states it will supply the exact brand-name hardware, explicitly noting this is not an 'or equal' submission, so no substitute-product documentation is required.

evidence.quote:
We will supply the exact handrail hardware and fasteners specified by
brand name in the Statement of Work; this is not an "or equal"
submission.

verdicts.description: Must provide a detailed capabilities statement or project narrative demonstrating how the company will successfully meet the needs of the statement of work.
verdicts.rationale: The Capabilities Statement claims the crew can mobilize and begin fabrication within 10 business days of award, but a later Financial Note states the current shop backlog means work cannot begin until at least 45 days after award -- the two stated start timelines for the same contract conflict.

evidence.quote:
Our crew can
mobilize and begin fabrication within 10 business days of award,
completing installation well within any reasonable schedule the
Government requires.

our current fabrication shop backlog
means work on any newly awarded contract, including this one, cannot
begin until at least 45 days after award, consistent with our present
production schedule.
